title: "Immune Classifier, Step 6: Final Validation on Held-Out Cells"
author: "Meite I, Pesce L, Feinstein M, Thorp EB, Lantz C"
date: "2026-03-06"
output: html_document
---

```{r final-validation}

# Phase 6: Final Validation
# Cardiac Immune Classifier

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SingleR)
  library(scuttle)   
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(yaml)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(class)
  library(caret)
  library(pROC)
  library(reshape2)
  library(gridExtra)
  library(here)
})

# Configuration
cat("Phase 6: Final Validation\n")

# Load config
config_path <- here::here("config", "config.yaml")
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)


# Load Validation Set
cat("\n[1/8] Loading validation set (blind holdout)...\n")

atlas_ref_path <- here::here(config$paths$atlas_reference)
seurat_atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

# Extract held-out validation set
val_cells <- colnames(seurat_atlas)[seurat_atlas$split == "validation"]
val_atlas <- seurat_atlas[, val_cells]

cat(sprintf("Validation set: %s cells across %d cell types\n",
            format(ncol(val_atlas), big.mark = ","),
            length(unique(val_atlas$cell_type))))

# Load Best Hyperparameters
cat("\n[2/8] Loading optimal hyperparameters from Phase 5...\n")

best_params <- readRDS(
  file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "models", "best_hyperparameters.rds")
)

best_k <- best_params$best_k
best_ratio <- best_params$best_smote_ratio
best_f1_test <- best_params$best_weighted_f1

cat(sprintf("Best k: %d\n", best_k))
cat(sprintf("Best SMOTE ratio: %s\n", best_ratio))
cat(sprintf("Test set F1: %.4f\n", best_f1_test))

# Load best training dataset
ratio_clean <- gsub(":", "_", best_ratio)
train_path <- file.path(
  config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "smote_balanced",
  paste0("train_smote_", ratio_clean, ".rds")
)
train_atlas <- readRDS(train_path)

cat(sprintf("Loaded training set: %s cells\n",
            format(ncol(train_atlas), big.mark = ",")))

# Apply k-NN Classifier with Probabilities
cat("\n[3/8] Running k-NN classifier with probability scores...\n")

# Extract PCA coordinates
train_pca <- Embeddings(train_atlas, reduction = "pca")[, 1:50]
train_labels <- train_atlas$cell_type
val_pca <- Embeddings(val_atlas, reduction = "pca")[, 1:50]
val_labels <- val_atlas$cell_type

# Ensure consistent factor levels
all_levels <- sort(unique(c(as.character(train_labels), as.character(val_labels))))
train_labels <- factor(train_labels, levels = all_levels)
val_labels <- factor(val_labels, levels = all_levels)

# Run k-NN with probabilities
predictions <- knn(
  train = train_pca,
  test = val_pca,
  cl = train_labels,
  k = best_k,
  prob = TRUE  
)

# Extract probabilities 
winner_prob <- attr(predictions, "prob")
max_probability <- winner_prob
predictions <- factor(predictions, levels = all_levels)

cat(sprintf("Predictions complete (k=%d)\n", best_k))

#Calculate Nearest Neighbor Distance
cat("\n[4/8] Computing nearest neighbor distances...\n")

# For each validation cell, find distance to nearest training cell
nn_distances <- numeric(nrow(val_pca))

for (i in 1:nrow(val_pca)) {
  # Calculate Euclidean distance to all training cells
  distances <- sqrt(rowSums((train_pca - rep(val_pca[i, ], each = nrow(train_pca)))^2))
  nn_distances[i] <- min(distances)
}



cat("KNN distances computed\n")

# Flag Unassigned Cells
cat("\n[5/8] Identifying unassigned/low-confidence cells...\n")

prob_threshold <- config$user_query$probability_threshold

# Flag cells with low confidence
unassigned <- max_probability < prob_threshold

cat(sprintf("  Probability threshold: %.2f\n", prob_threshold))
cat(sprintf("  Unassigned cells: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(unassigned),
            100 * sum(unassigned) / length(unassigned)))

# Create unassigned cells dataframe
unassigned_df <- data.frame(
  cell_id = colnames(val_atlas)[unassigned],
  true_label = as.character(val_labels[unassigned]),
  predicted_label = as.character(predictions[unassigned]),
  max_probability = max_probability[unassigned],
  nn_distance = nn_distances[unassigned],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Run atlas-reference SingleR on validation set
cat("\n[6/8] Running ImmGen for comparison...\n")

# Load atlas SingleR reference
atlas_ref_path <- "/projects/b1246/Isaac/atlas_reference.rds"

if (!file.exists(atlas_ref_path)) {
  cat("Atlas reference not found, skipping ImmGen comparison\n")
  run_immgen <- FALSE
} else {
  run_immgen <- TRUE
  
  atlas_reference <- readRDS(atlas_ref_path)
  
  # Convert validation set to SCE
  val_counts <- GetAssayData(val_atlas, assay = "SCT", layer = "counts")
  val_sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = val_counts))
  val_sce <- logNormCounts(val_sce)
  
gene_map <- read.csv(here::here(config$paths$gene_map), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  cat(sprintf("Loaded gene map: %d entries\n", nrow(gene_map)))
  
  # Convert val_sce rownames from Ensembl to symbols
  val_genes_ensembl <- rownames(val_sce)
  
  # Match Ensembl IDs to symbols
  gene_map_match <- gene_map[match(val_genes_ensembl, gene_map$ensembl_gene_id), ]
  
  # Keep only genes that have a match
  valid_idx <- !is.na(gene_map_match$mgi_symbol)
  val_sce <- val_sce[valid_idx, ]
  
  # Rename with symbols
  rownames(val_sce) <- gene_map_match$mgi_symbol[valid_idx]
  
  cat(sprintf("Converted %d genes to symbols\n", sum(valid_idx)))
  
  # Find common genes
  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(val_sce), rownames(atlas_reference))
  
  cat(sprintf("Common genes: %d\n", length(common_genes)))
  
  if (length(common_genes) < 100) {
    cat("Too few common genes, skipping ImmGen comparison\n")
    run_immgen <- FALSE
  } else {
    # Subset both to common genes
    val_sce <- val_sce[common_genes, ]
    atlas_reference <- atlas_reference[common_genes, ]
    
    # Run SingleR
    cat("Running SingleR annotation...\n")
    immgen_pred <- SingleR(
      test = val_sce,
      ref = atlas_reference,
      labels = colnames(atlas_reference)
    )
    
    immgen_predictions <- factor(immgen_pred$labels, levels = all_levels)
    
    cat("ImmGen predictions complete\n")
  }
}

# Calculate Metrics for Both Classifiers
cat("\n[7/8] Computing performance metrics...\n")

# Classifier
our_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
  data = predictions[!unassigned],  # Exclude unassigned
  reference = val_labels[!unassigned]
)

our_per_class <- our_conf_matrix$byClass
if (is.null(dim(our_per_class))) {
  our_per_class <- t(as.matrix(our_per_class))
}

# Fix class names (remove "Class: " prefix)
our_f1 <- our_per_class[, "F1"]
names(our_f1) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(our_per_class))
our_precision <- our_per_class[, "Precision"]
names(our_precision) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(our_per_class))
our_recall <- our_per_class[, "Recall"]
names(our_recall) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(our_per_class))

# Calculate weighted F1
val_class_counts <- table(val_labels[!unassigned])
val_class_weights <- val_class_counts / sum(val_class_counts)
cell_types_in_val <- names(val_class_counts)
our_f1_aligned <- our_f1[cell_types_in_val]
our_f1_aligned[is.na(our_f1_aligned)] <- 0
our_weighted_f1 <- sum(our_f1_aligned * as.numeric(val_class_weights), na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("\nClassifier:\n"))
cat(sprintf("Weighted F1: %.4f\n", our_weighted_f1))
cat(sprintf("Accuracy: %.4f\n", our_conf_matrix$overall["Accuracy"]))

# Atlas SingleR
if (run_immgen) {
  immgen_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
    data = immgen_predictions,
    reference = val_labels
  )
  
  immgen_per_class <- immgen_conf_matrix$byClass
  if (is.null(dim(immgen_per_class))) {
    immgen_per_class <- t(as.matrix(immgen_per_class))
  }
  
  immgen_f1 <- immgen_per_class[, "F1"]
  names(immgen_f1) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(immgen_per_class))
  immgen_precision <- immgen_per_class[, "Precision"]
  names(immgen_precision) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(immgen_per_class))
  immgen_recall <- immgen_per_class[, "Recall"]
  names(immgen_recall) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(immgen_per_class))
  
  immgen_f1_aligned <- immgen_f1[cell_types_in_val]
  immgen_f1_aligned[is.na(immgen_f1_aligned)] <- 0
  immgen_weighted_f1 <- sum(immgen_f1_aligned * as.numeric(val_class_weights), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\nImmGen:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Weighted F1: %.4f\n", immgen_weighted_f1))
  cat(sprintf("Accuracy: %.4f\n", immgen_conf_matrix$overall["Accuracy"]))
}

# Generate Visualizations
cat("\n[8/8] Generating publication figures...\n")

results_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "figures", "phase6_validation")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Figure 1: F1 Comparison
if (run_immgen) {
  comparison_df <- data.frame(
    Cell_Type = names(our_f1),
    Classifier = our_f1,
    ImmGen = immgen_f1[names(our_f1)]
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Classifier, ImmGen),
                 names_to = "Method",
                 values_to = "F1") %>%
    mutate(F1 = ifelse(is.na(F1), 0, F1))
  
  p_f1_comparison <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = Cell_Type, y = F1, fill = Method)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Classifier" = "#2E7D32", "ImmGen" = "#D32F2F"),
                  labels = c("Classifier" = "Classifier", "ImmGen" = "Atlas SingleR"))  +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Cell Type Classification Performance: Classifier vs Atlas SingleR",
      subtitle = sprintf("Validation Set (n=%s cells)", format(ncol(val_atlas), big.mark=",")),
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "F1 Score",
      fill = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "phase6_F1_comparison.png"),
    plot = p_f1_comparison,
    width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300
  )
  
  cat("Saved F1 comparison\n")
}

# Figure 2: Confusion Matrices 
# classifier
conf_df_ours <- as.data.frame(our_conf_matrix$table)
p_conf_ours <- ggplot(conf_df_ours, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2E7D32", name = "Count") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Classifier (F1=%.4f)", our_weighted_f1),
    x = "True Label",
    y = "Predicted Label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "phase6_confusion_matrix_ours.png"),
  plot = p_conf_ours,
  width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300
)

if (run_immgen) {
  conf_df_immgen <- as.data.frame(immgen_conf_matrix$table)
  p_conf_immgen <- ggplot(conf_df_immgen, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#D32F2F", name = "Count") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Atlas SingleR (F1=%.4f)", immgen_weighted_f1),
      x = "True Label",
      y = "Predicted Label"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "phase6_confusion_matrix_atlas_singler.png"),
    plot = p_conf_immgen,
    width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300
  )
}

cat("Saved confusion matrices\n")

#Figure 3: Confidence Landscape
confidence_df <- data.frame(
  max_probability = max_probability,
  nn_distance = nn_distances,
  assigned = ifelse(unassigned, "Unassigned", "Assigned"),
  correct = predictions == val_labels
)

p_confidence <- ggplot(confidence_df, aes(x = max_probability, y = nn_distance, color = assigned)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Assigned" = "#2E7D32", "Unassigned" = "#D32F2F")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = prob_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Classifier Confidence Landscape",
    subtitle = sprintf("Threshold: %.2f | Unassigned: %d cells (%.1f%%)",
                      prob_threshold, sum(unassigned), 100*sum(unassigned)/length(unassigned)),
    x = "k-NN vote fraction",
    y = "Nearest Neighbor Distance",
    color = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "phase6_confidence_landscape.png"),
  plot = p_confidence,
  width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300
)


# Save Results
cat("\nSaving results...\n")

metrics_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "metrics")

# Per-cell-type metrics
if (run_immgen) {
  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    Cell_Type = names(our_f1),
    Classifier_Precision = our_precision,
    Classifier_Recall = our_recall,
    Classifier_F1 = our_f1,
    AtlasSingleR_Precision = immgen_precision[names(our_f1)],
    AtlasSingleR_Recall = immgen_recall[names(our_f1)],
    ImmGen_F1 = AtlasSingleR_F1 = immgen_f1[names(our_f1)]
  )
} else {
  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    Cell_Type = names(our_f1),
    Classifier_Precision = our_precision,
    Classifier_Recall = our_recall,
    Classifier_F1 = our_f1
  )
}

write.csv(
  metrics_df,
  file = file.path(metrics_dir, "phase6_final_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Unassigned cells
write.csv(
  unassigned_df,
  file = file.path(metrics_dir, "phase6_unassigned_cells.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Summary
cat("Phase 6 Complete: Final Validation\n")

cat("Summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("Validation cells: %s\n", format(ncol(val_atlas), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Classifier Weighted F1: %.4f\n", our_weighted_f1))
if (run_immgen) {
  cat(sprintf("ImmGen Weighted F1: %.4f\n", immgen_weighted_f1))
  cat(sprintf("Improvement: +%.4f (%.1f%%)\n",
              our_weighted_f1 - immgen_weighted_f1,
              100 * (our_weighted_f1 - immgen_weighted_f1) / immgen_weighted_f1))
}
cat(sprintf("Unassigned cells: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(unassigned), 100*sum(unassigned)/length(unassigned)))

cat("\nPublication figures saved to:\n")
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", results_dir))


```
